questions.q: Explain how the earth wire and fuse work together to protect a person using a metal kettle with a fault. Portal response box.
questions.a: Live wire touches the metal case (1); earth wire connects case to ground with low resistance (1); large current flows to earth (1); current exceeds fuse rating (1); fuse melts, breaking the live connection (1); case is no longer live, so no shock (1).
questions.model: Teacher writes the first link: 'If a fault makes the live wire touch the metal case, a large current flows through the low-resistance earth wire rather than through a person.'

questions.a: So when it melts the appliance is disconnected from the high voltage (1); the appliance is safe to touch (1).
